arguments.name: autoscalingGroupName
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the Auto Scaling group.

arguments.name: identifier
arguments.description: (Required) Identifies the traffic source. For Application Load Balancers, Gateway Load Balancers, Network Load Balancers, and VPC Lattice, this will be the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for a target group in this account and Region. For Classic Load Balancers, this will be the name of the Classic Load Balancer in this account and Region.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: (Required) Provides additional context for the value of `identifier`.
